inputs.text: These Nigerian health workers are really stirring up trouble by opting for disruptive protests over embracing the reforms that would reinforce our national authority and introduce much-needed accountability. On Thursday, the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations gathered in the streets of Abuja at the Unity Fountain in Maitama, protesting reform bills in the National Assembly. This kind of agitation only serves to undermine social order, shows a clear rejection of personal responsibility, and puts union self-interest ahead of the stability families count on for vital services. It's just more evidence of self-serving groups eroding the traditions and authority essential to keeping the nation strong.
